title: Garden Valley School Division
description:
https://www.gvsd.ca/
									Garden Valley School District is a Manitoba public school district with a student population of approximately 4,300. Their negligent attitude toward their own and their students' safety has resulted in the compromise of confidential student, staff, and health information, including student information system databases (names, dates of birth, grades, attendance, disciplinary and special education records), employee payroll records and bank account information, employee personnel files, accounting spreadsheets, student and staff data files, and district administrative records. This breach of information will result in a FIPPA/PHIA, notification to affected individuals, and potential penalties for violation.
